name: oot_enemy_parasitic_tentacle
author: Skijer
description: Ocarina of Time's Parasitic Tentacle from inside Jabu-Jabu in Majora's Mask: it hangs from above and lashes at you when you come close. Only Zora's boomerang can hurt it. Custom enemy oot.parasitic_tentacle and its soul soul.oot.parasitic_tentacle. Uses OoT Asset Loader resources.
